name: WordPress.com
description:
Manage and create on your WordPress site through a conversation with Claude. Ask Claude to find a post, check your stats, draft something new, update a page, or pull up a comment thread. Your sites stay secure — Claude only gets access to what you approve, nothing more.

Your site already knows your style — your theme, your colors, your fonts, every creative decision you've made. Claude can see all of it, so when it helps you create, the content actually fits.

60+ abilities. Every change is confirmed by you. Available on all paid WordPress.com plans and any Jetpack AI or Complete-connected site.

For developers: Under the hood, this connector is powered by the WordPress.com MCP server. It uses OAuth 2.1 to ensure agents only access the resources you've explicitly approved, making it easy for you to build and extend AI-driven workflows on top of WordPress.

_published_faq.name: How do I add WordPress.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add WordPress.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://public-api.wordpress.com/wpcom/v2/mcp/v1. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the WordPress.com MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: WordPress.com lists 16 MCP tools, including user-profile, user-sites, user-domains, user-achievements, user-connections, user-notifications, user-notifications-inbox, user-security, user-subscriptions, site-users, posts-search, and post-get.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to WordPress.com?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to WordPress.com in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
WordPress.com requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
WordPress.com is developed by Automattic (WordPress.com). It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
